donate here: lindenpantry.example/mrkz

$250: chat picks my hair dye color and i do it ON STREAM

- show up, join lobbies, clip stuff, send the stream to ppl

and if u cant give anything, come anyway. zero guilt fr, more ppl in chat helps too

the plan: first half is community lobbies, anyone can join, ill drop the code. second half chat votes on the game every 2 hrs. no repeat maps, i promise

nov 21. put it in ur phone. see u there
